rule.description: A function or method signature contains a window of at least 4 neighbouring parameter names that is also declared, identically and in the same order, in at least 3 distinct function or method signatures spanning at least 3 distinct modules. Only maximal windows are reported; every signature declaring a reported group is one match.

checks.description: The identity facts of the benchmarked cluster (distribution flavor, distribution version, build revision, target id, target platform, target auth type) are declared as one window of neighbouring parameters in signature after signature across the preparation path instead of being carried by a single cohesive representation.
checks.detected_relation: signature -> repeatedly co-declared neighbouring parameter window (6 members) shared across 5 signatures in 4 modules
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The six values always describe the same thing - the cluster the race benchmarks - and are always passed together, yet every carrier along the path declares them as unrelated individual parameters; the group has no owning abstraction, so each new fact must be added by hand at every signature. This is the data-clump interface-bloat relation.

matches.evidence: Constructor of the inter-actor completion message lists the whole identity group as individual parameters: distribution_flavor, distribution_version, revision, target_id, target_platform, target_auth_type (esrally/driver/driver.py:137).

Module-level helper that stores the target cluster's facts on the main driver actor takes every identity fact as its own parameter, preceded only by the recipient actor and the raw cluster response (esrally/driver/driver.py:216).

Race-model method that records the benchmarked cluster's identity on the race declares the whole group again as individual parameters (distribution_flavor, distribution_version, revision, target_id=None, target_platform=None, target_auth_type=None) (esrally/metrics.py:1995).

Race-control coordinator method that receives the facts when track preparation completes and hands them to the race record declares the identical neighbouring parameter window (esrally/racecontrol.py:260).
Telemetry publishing helper that writes the identity facts as cluster-scoped meta-info takes the same six neighbouring parameters one by one after the metrics store (esrally/telemetry.py:1805).

excluded.candidate: pipeline selection flags (sources, distribution, external, docker) in race-control pipelines and engine-start messages
excluded.reason: selects which provisioning pipeline runs; a different conceptual unit, not the benchmark target's identity group

excluded.candidate: client connection parameters (host lists, client options) passed to client factories and metrics stores
excluded.reason: connection plumbing shared by many callers; never co-declared with the identity group

excluded.candidate: serverless runtime bundle (build hash, serverless mode flag, operator flag) forwarded to telemetry setup
excluded.reason: three-value runtime-mode group; overlaps only the derivation context, not the identity values

excluded.candidate: race context tuple (race id, race timestamp, track, challenge, car) keying metrics-store contexts and results
excluded.reason: identifies the race, not the target cluster; a separate domain group
